nodes.gate: Exact Erista/Mariko board and authorized ADSP availability, startup and recovery; distinguish USB mass storage from CPU execution.
Authorized AMP startup and protected arbitration; prove ADSP boot support, not assume EL2 or Bao is required on the physical path.
Keep all four Cortex-A57 cores with Horizon; prove ADSP-local execution, MMU, accessible RAM, disjoint reservations, cache attributes and isolation.
Verify ADSP interrupt/timer availability, shared-memory visibility, notification and DMA ownership; no cross-domain writes.
Single hardware owner per device; prove audio preservation, mediated access and recoverable handoff.
Versioned bounded mixed ARMv7/AArch64 bridge; prove atomic width, cache ordering, notification, timeout and restart on target. R32/R35 only provide ARM64 reference evidence.
FreeBSD/armv7 network endpoint and native sshd reachable over approved LAN/VPN during Horizon title; prove mediated or exclusive NIC ownership and ARMv7 service build.
Native title execution while BSD SSH and heartbeat remain live; measure memory, CPU and frame time.
One catalog, provider-specific runnable state, legitimate native launch and Steam metadata.
Single capability registry consumed by Steam integration, BSD CLI and KDE, policy #55.
Actual KDE desktop and return to Gaming Mode without reboot.
Physical end-to-end acceptance including clean SD install and recovery, audio, CPU/RAM/frame budgets, display/HID transitions and save integrity; preserve internal eMMC.

FreeBSD 15.1-RELEASE GENERICSD on QEMU virt Cortex-A15, SHA256/SHA512 verified, console uname confirms FreeBSD armv7. Not ADSP boot or native IPC acceptance.

QEMU Linux user mode Cortex-A9 and Cortex-A57, 128 frames each direction with both role assignments, all four exit codes zero; not FreeBSD IPC or physical cache coherence. Earlier independent job 139560877553 also passed.

evidence: Pinned source recipes and separately scoped CI evidence. Edges describe integration, not complete package dependency closure. Reference evidence does not satisfy physical gates. No physical Switch execution or full SteamOS runtime proven. Physical AMP target is explicitly separate from the ARM64 reference recipes; no ADSP execution is proven.
